|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]]): Virtual Block 5 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 83)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010, first printing not found), page 9, slip 83. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-83-Obi_Wan_In_Radiant_VII.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (Light Side p. 50)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=50 Internet Archive]</ref> reprints it character for character; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]]), and the current text. The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “83” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1250_83">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not cloak. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” '''What changed:''' The quote marks around “cloak” are dropped, and the list prints the title “Obi-Wan in Radiant VII”, with a small i in “in” (card-list title capitals are versions, ruling of 10 November 2026). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1250_83">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. The card list itself was generated from that Holotable data (research R7, 11 November 2026): a transcription the Players Committee published, listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-obiwaninradiantvii-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]]) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “83” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 50)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII]]) again, word for word: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent pilot is •Obi-Wan, who provides ability of 6. Opponent's starships may not 'cloak'. Your total ability here may not be reduced.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-83-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “83”).
